basic_info.description: This fully-detached Spanish Mediterranean home radiates timeless San Francisco charm from the heart of the Portola district. Classic 1940s details with original parquet wood floors and walnut inlay, arched doorways, tray ceilings, and original wood doors, create a warm, elegant backdrop throughout. The formal living room features arched windows with a Juliet balcony and a striking fireplace, flowing into a bright, spacious dining room ideal for gatherings. Beyond, French doors open to a cheerful breakfast room with skylight ceiling bathing the home in natural light. Upstairs are two generous bedrooms overlooking the garden, a vintage kitchen, a pastel-tiled bath with separate tub & shower, and ample natural light throughout. A versatile lower-level bonus room with half bath offers flexibility for a guest suite, home office, or media room. The sunny backyard includes a flat patio and raised garden beds, perfect for outdoor entertaining. Finished with an oversized 2-car garage plus driveway parking, W/D hookups, endless amounts of storage space or substantial expansion potential. Only minutes to McLaren Park's 312-acre park, golf course, pool, tennis courts, sports fields & 7 miles of walking trails and 101/280 freeway access, making this a super accessible place to call home.
